subtitleNullable: Thermal Image Refinement with Depth Estimation using Recurrent Networks for Mono
licenseNameNullable: Database: Open Database, Contents: Database Contents
descriptionNullable:
This dataset was collected for our accepted paper at the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026).

The dataset follows the same structure as the VIVID++ format. It primarily consists of thermal and depth image pairs, where each depth image is spatially aligned with its corresponding thermal image. The processed image data can be accessed via the provided dataset.zip file.

All sequences contain aligned thermal and depth images. In some sequences, additional RGB images are provided to better illustrate the experimental scenarios. Furthermore, for the zoom_* and no_zoom_* sequences, ground-truth position data obtained from a Vicon motion capture system is included.

In addition, we provide the trained model based on a Liquid Recurrent Block architecture used in our thermal-to-depth framework.

For evaluation purposes, two ROS bag files are included. These bag files can be used to test and validate the thermal-to-depth model using real sensor recordings.

If you use this dataset, please cite our paper.
